description: Build an invoice_create-ready payload from the lines, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing and marks nothing: raise the invoice in the invoice server, then set this order invoiced. Pro.

issue_date.description: The invoice issue date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

tax_rate.description: VAT percent per line, overriding the shared business profile's default rate

work_order.description: The work order id, e.g. WO-2026-0001, or the client name when only one job is theirs

name: work_order_invoice_payload
title: Invoice payload for a work order
